title: CovFedAvg: Local Low-Loss Curves and Federated Model Selection
abstract: arXiv:2610.39902v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Clients observing different parts of a prediction task may learn locally equivalent models with incompatible behavior outside their observed support. We study whether redundant models permit local low-loss paths toward a compatible shared model. CovFedAvg retains local models and curve controls on clients, fits a common endpoint through aggregated gradient contributions, and selects an actual candidate model using distributed training losses. No centralized calibration examples or client-to-client sample exchange are required. Exact selection guarantees no higher evaluated training loss than the previous model and the current-round FedAvg candidate; this is not a global-optimality, stationarity, generalization, or differential-privacy guarantee. We state conditional client-compatibility and approximate-selection bounds and retain corrected transformation identities and a separate full-gradient safeguard theorem for reference algorithms

translated_title: CovFedAvg：局部低损失曲线与联邦模型选择
translated_abstract: 观察预测任务不同部分的客户端可能学习到局部等价但在其观测支撑域之外行为互不兼容的模型。我们研究冗余模型是否能够提供通向兼容共享模型的局部低损失路径。CovFedAvg 在客户端保留本地模型和曲线控制，通过聚合梯度贡献拟合一个共同端点，并使用分布式训练损失来选择实际的候选模型。该方法无需集中式校准样本，也无需客户端之间的样本交换。精确选择保证所评估的训练损失不高于先前模型以及当前轮次 FedAvg 候选模型的损失；但这并非全局最优性、平稳性、泛化或差分隐私方面的保证。我们给出了条件性的客户端兼容性界和近似选择界，并保留了修正后的变换恒等式以及针对参考算法的独立全梯度保障定理。
tldr: 提出CovFedAvg联邦学习方法，在客户端保留本地模型并通过聚合梯度贡献拟合共同端点、利用分布式训练损失进行模型选择，在无需集中校准数据或客户端间样本交换的前提下，保证所选模型训练损失不高于先前模型和当前FedAvg候选模型。
